card.name: Frequency and interval words in dosing
card.fires_on: Words that start a frequency or interval phrase in dosing directions, such as twice, times, each, last, or decrements. A few non-drug passages with counts or amounts also trigger it.

modes.label: Dose frequency words
modes.description: Twice or times after an oral dose, just before daily or per day.

modes.label: Schedule and interval words
modes.description: Words that set the step or cycle for a dose change or infusion.
modes.example: withdrawn by 20% decre<<ments>> each week over a 4-week period

modes.label: Counts in general text
modes.description: Number or amount words in non-drug text, such as average or seven before a noun.
modes.example: has risen from an<< average>> of 33,000

card.plain: It fires on the small words that say how often or how regularly a dose is given, like twice or each.
